title: Initialize @rivetjs/nx
description: Adds @rivetjs/nx and the shared Rivet tooling to the workspace and registers the inference plugin in nx.json.

addPlugin.description: Register @rivetjs/nx/plugin in nx.json (inferred targets). Default: true unless NX_ADD_PLUGINS=false or nx.json useInferencePlugins is false.

skipPackageJson.description: Do not add dependencies to the root package.json.

skipInstall.description: Do not run the package manager install.
